access_used: public sample in paper/repo/card only (full data sent by email after an access-request form; CC BY-NC 4.0 plus a no-redistribution usage statement)
note: Zenodo hosts only the README and the access form. Example 1 is the README's own example of a professional session's skill-step file and hand-action file (start frame, end frame, label; steps may overlap). Examples 2–3 are real ground-truth files for benchmark videos from the public evaluation repo (tab-separated start frame, end frame, skill id, step text; CRLF line endings kept). Frames were converted to seconds assuming 30 fps, the rate the README gives for the professional mp4s; the benchmark videos' rate is not stated. The in-lab error labels (skipped, added or incorrect steps) are described in the README but no example is public. No clip.

examples.raw:
An example of the file format for a “skill\_labels\_by\_frame” appears below:
  
```
278     519     Place tourniquet over affected extremity 2-3 inches above wound site.
555     664     Pull tourniquet tight.
675     774     Apply strap to strap body.
808     1002    Turn windless clock wise or counter clockwise until hemorrhage is controlled.
982     1001    Lock windless into the windless keeper.
1042    1151    Secure strap and windless keeper with keeper securing device.
1226    1293    Mark time on securing device strap with permanent marker.
```

The columns are `start_frame end_frame label` in this data (and would be `start_time end_time label` for the "seconds" version). Note that consecutive labels may have overlapping frame/time windows if multiple actions are occurring simultaneously.

The corresponding "action_labels_by_frame" file appears below:

```
278     318     hands open_up tourniquet
367     519     hands put_tourniquet_around casualty_leg
555     664     left_hand pulls_tight tourniquet
675     774     left_hand secures velcro_strap
808     1002    hands twist windlass
982     1001    both_hands lock_into_windlass_keeper windlass
1042    1151    left_hand secures windlass
1226    1293    left_hand writes_on tourniquet_label
```

Note that the first two action labels are combined into one as they are part of a single step.

examples.title: M2-eval1 (tourniquet benchmark video): 8 ground-truth skill steps

timeline.text: Place tourniquet over affected extremity 2-3 inches above wound site.
Pull tourniquet tight.
Apply strap to strap body.
Turn windless clock wise or counter clockwise until hemorrhage is controlled.
Lock windless into the windless keeper.
Pull excess strap over the windless keeper.
Secure strap and windless keeper with keeper securing device.
Mark time on securing device strap with permanent marker.

examples.title: R19-eval1 (needle chest decompression benchmark video): 6 ground-truth skill steps

timeline.text: Locate insertion site at the second intercostal space at the midclavicular line.
Wipe the insertion site with an alcohol wipe.
Prepare catheter and needle.
Insert needle into insertion site.
Remove needle, keeping catheter inside the patient.
Apply tape around catheter to secure it in place.
